svg.title: SemaphoreMap in Egres: row locks keyed by row hash with a wait-for graph; a request that would close a wait cycle is refused with a deadlock error before it parks
svg.desc: Three transactions each lock one row: T1 holds r1, T2 holds r2, T3 holds r3. T1 then asks for r2 and parks behind T2; T2 asks for r3 and parks behind T3. When T3 asks for r1, held by T1, the map walks the wait-for graph before parking: T1 waits for T2, T2 waits for T3, back to T3. The request is refused with a deadlock error, T3 aborts and releases r3, T2 wakes and commits, T1 wakes and commits. No cycle ever formed and no timeout was needed.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: EGRES · SEMAPHOREMAP · ROW LOCKS, A WAIT-FOR GRAPH, DEADLOCKS REFUSED AT THE DOOR
